type.description: The schema this one names: a schema document's URL (`hm://…` or `ipfs://<cid>`). Naming one of the nine kinds grounds a schema instead (see the kind-rooted variants), so a kind URL does not belong here. The other keys refine what is named.

properties.description: Fields the extension adds to (or overrides in) the base struct, as properties.

target.description: For a reference-valued string (`format: hm-url` or `format: ipfs-url`): the schema the referenced document or object is expected to conform to — an `hm://` schema-document URL or `ipfs://<cid>`. Advisory: an editor pre-seeds and validates the target against it; a validator does not dereference the reference.
